note: A world_buildings fragment (src/buildings.cpp): res/systems/old_system.json names it under "world_buildings_files" and the loader merges these entries into its own "world_buildings". Hand-authored -- utils/gen_systems.py emits only the reference, never this table, so regenerating the system JSON cannot clobber a coordinate. old_system is the frozen legacy fixture (Eerbon + its moon, no belts), so this table stays small on purpose: it exists to pin that the fragment mechanism works for a fictional system too. The FIRST entry is the game's default site (find_launch_site falls back to the first VAB_LAUNCH_PAD, and merged fragments come before a system's inline world_buildings); the polar pad is inline in the system JSON instead.
